description: Default joint position offsets (radians) for the Open Duck Mini v2 action post-processing: target = init_pos + action_scale * action. Values are the standing pose from isaac_lab_env/open_duck_mini_v2/robot_cfg.py (ArticulationCfg.init_state.joint_pos). joint_order is the Isaac Lab / USD articulation joint order produced by the MJCF-to-USD conversion (breadth-first, interleaved) and is the order of the policy's 16 action outputs and of the joint_pos/joint_vel observation blocks.
